FAO Save on Rates.body:
Hi {{firstname}},

We're currently working with a number of businesses who are feeling the squeeze from rising wages, supplier costs, and increasing business rates.

As part of our payments bundle, we're helping operators streamline their setup, reduce costs, and unlock additional value, including:

• Savings on processing rates compared to many current providers
• Free on-device POS
• Free website hosting with ongoing management
• Simple and efficient Pay-by-Link & MOTO for card-not-present transactions
• 24/7 UK-based phone support
• Real-time reporting via a mobile app
• Additional revenue through on-terminal advertising
• Access to capital funding when needed

I appreciate you may already have a strong incumbent in place, but it would be useful to run a quick comparison against your current setup — we often uncover small changes that make a noticeable difference both commercially and operationally.

Best regards,
